source_refs.note: 1. Industrial Activities: a main subheading of 33.4 Water Pollution due to Human Activities, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 254-254.

blocks.text: Industry pani ki pollution ka sab se bara source hai. Factories aksar harmful (nuqsan-deh) chemicals, heavy metals aur zehreela waste seedha daryaon, jheelon aur samandaron mein daal deti hain. Pollution phailane wali aam industries: oil refineries, chemical plants, gariyon ki industry (automobile), fertilizer (khaad) ki factories aur tanneries (chamra rangne ke karkhane) waghera.
